title: First dream in a while and it's in a mall, partially
content: It's been a while since I had a dream at all. Finally had a dream that I can remember and it's in a mall for part of it. The other part is a chase sequence, because of course it is. Side note, I notice my dreams are more memorable and eventful when I've been sleep deprived. Wonder why? So I don't remember it THAT well, it was in bits. So I'll just list off things that happened. * I was in Casper, Wyoming. I don't live there. I was trying to get out of Casper because the police were after me for something I did in the city, don't remember what. They were REALLY after me too, like setting up blockades and high-speed chases. The front axle on my car suddenly broke and I crashed. * After the crash, I was in a whole new setting. Maybe I died? Anyway, it was a really wacky outdoor setting. Bright colors and didn't feel real. Kind of like the setting of the 2003 live action Cat in the Hat movie. There was K-pop playing from...somewhere. I was back in my car which was now free of damage and running smoothly, on a road to nowhere. * The scene changed again. Now I'm at the mall. I'm grilling indoors. For some idiotic reason I left the still-flaming grill to go shopping in the mall for an hour. The mall itself was just an empty clone of the one from where I live, with a loudspeaker announcing the time every 15 minutes, since it closed soon. Guess what? The mall caught fire from my grill. I stood outside the mall watching the fire department respond to it.
